implementation: Accepted permit and RSS observations use conservative matching. Owner/company names and city-only locations do not merge records; stable identifier scope, physical site, conflicting geography, and ambiguous candidates are retained with version-bound rationale.

Lifecycle event rows bind to retained evidence versions. Corrections retain old events while projections use the latest accepted, hash-bound evidence for each observation. Out-of-order current milestones resolve by lifecycle order.

Event dates come only from supported evidence event_date fields and compatible labels. Publication dates stay separate. Future or negated milestone language is not treated as an actual event. Lifecycle estimates remain separate from commercial tier, requirement, and gap.

Migration 0006 adds identity provenance and version-aware event uniqueness, selectively removes unsupported legacy occurrence dates, and resets only affected projections. The explicit replay entrypoint requires an explicit target selection for the application DB, checks schema version 0006, and reports bound/unbound/unresolved counts.
